name: Bianca Must Die
source:
After a year of planning, Whitley attempts to murder her girlfriend, Bianca.

[i]“Go ahead,”[/i] says Bianca.

Will you take her up on that, or listen to what she has to say?

[From [url=https://reverietiime.itch.io/bianca-must-die]itch.io[/url]]
